page_title: HOF 1-1 KOL | Hoffenheim v FC Koln 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+4' After receiving a beautiful pass, Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) had a huge opportunity. He coolly unleashed a perfect shot, which went in off the right post.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Timo Schultz has decided to substitute Jan Thielmann and he is replaced by Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln).
89' Substitution. Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) has come on for Max Finkgrafe.
87' Oliver Baumann displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
84' The referee gives a yellow card to Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln).
83' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) brings an opponent down and Christian Dingert interrupts the game.
82' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim) replacing Ihlas Bebou.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Skov trots off the pitch and is replaced by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim).
81' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
79' 0 - 1 Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) scores a great goal from the resulting free kick from mid-range. He sends the ball directly inside the right post.
78' That's a clear yellow card. Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) goes into the book.
76' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
76' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is booked for saying more than Christian Dingert was willing to tolerate.
75' Corner kicks – 9:3.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Faride Alidou departs the field of play to be replaced by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).
72' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
72' Hoffenheim earn a corner. A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.

71' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hoffenheim.
71' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
68' The game has come to an end for Umut Tohumcu. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Anton Stach (Hoffenheim).
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) will be replaced by Kevin Akpoguma.
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is replacing Wout Weghorst.
66' FC Koln take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

66' A lofted cross from Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to FC Koln.
65' The resulting corner from Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) is cleared.
64' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
64' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is penalised for a foul. Christian Dingert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
61' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
60' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but it's cleared.
58' The substitution is prepared. Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Florian Kainz.
57' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) launches a cross from the corner, but Marvin Schwabe is alert to thwart the effort.
55' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
55' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt only went low to the middle of the goal, so Marvin Schwabe stops it easily.
54' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' FC Koln take a short corner kick.
53' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Christian Dingert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) has time in the box after a cross from Pavel Kaderabek, but places his shot high over the bar.
45+1' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

44' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) brings his opponent down. Christian Dingert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. FC Koln will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
43' A short pass from Robert Skov puts Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails high over the bar.
40' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
39' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
38' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
32' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
31' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) serves up a nice cross, but Oliver Baumann punches the ball away.
31' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. It will be a corner kick for Hoffenheim.
26' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
21' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes a short corner kick.
21' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) sprays a pass out to Pavel Kaderabek, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
19' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Christian Dingert stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
16' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
15' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
14' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
12' Hoffenheim hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
8' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
7' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
5' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Christian Dingert immediately signals a free kick.
3' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
2' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Christian Dingert is the one to supervise the game today.
